Fit tests

  • Seven long steps
  • Seven detailed items
  • One line picks the shape (2)

Seven long steps

  1. Maplist the coverage dimensions for the topic
  2. Researchsearch the authoritative sources first
  3. Draftwrite version zero point one
  4. Refinerevise sections by their numbers
  5. Reviewcheck it in a fresh chat
  6. Approverecord the gate decision
  7. Buildassemble and check the deck

Seven detailed items

  • Briefwho attends, why now and how long the session runs
  • Seedstranscripts, notes and earlier outlines worth mining
  • Researchofficial documentation and primary sources first
  • Outlinenumbered sections that map straight to slides
  • Reviewa fresh chat that isn't anchored to earlier drafts
  • Approvalan explicit decision recorded in the decisions log
  • Deckone build from the approved outline, then checks
